$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Written from scratch for OneMind (issue #855).
title: OneMind radio status (onemind.radio.status/v1)
description: What a LoRa radio reports about itself, in physical units, never vendor preset or region tables. Built by onemindd from MeshCore SELF_INFO (0x05), DEVICE_INFO (0x0D) and BATTERY (0x0C) and returned by the signed lora.status job; served by GET /v1/radios (#854). OneMind only reads these values in 1.0: it never writes frequency, bandwidth, spreading factor, coding rate or power.

model.description: DEVICE_INFO model (the board's manufacturer name), matched against the guard's grant table

max_tx_power_dbm.description: What the firmware build allows, not what the law or the FCC grant allows

public_key.description: An opaque id of the radio's identity; clients never parse it

read_at.description: When SELF_INFO was read; the guard refuses a send on a stale reading
